tokenName: Investrust Bank Agri Warehouse Receipt Token
description: Investrust Bank aggregates warehouse receipts from rural cooperatives and smallholder storage facilities across Zambia and structures them into investable digital tokens. Farmer groups receive immediate liquidity against stored produce while investors gain commodity-backed income. Reduces post-harvest losses and creates stable farmgate employment.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Informal Services Contract Token
description: Investrust Bank structures pools of verified gig and informal economy contracts in Zambia into investable instruments. Plumbers, electricians, caterers, security guards and cleaning service providers receive DID-verified digital contracts, enabling them to access advance payment against future earnings. Reduces the financial vulnerability of informal workers.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Community Infrastructure PPP Token
description: Investrust Bank structures public-private partnership infrastructure projects with mandatory local employment clauses in Zambia. Token holders finance road, bridge, school and hospital construction projects that must employ a minimum 70% of local citizens. Revenue-sharing distributions paid on project completion milestones.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia PPP Act; Employment-Linked Infrastructure Token Policy

tokenName: Investrust Bank Social Housing REIT Token
underlyingAsset: Social and affordable housing investment — Zambia
description: Investrust Bank structures tokenised social housing portfolios in Zambia, enabling anyone to invest in government and private affordable housing programmes. Returns from rental income and property appreciation are distributed to all token holders. Creates housing supply, rental income for ordinary investors, and construction jobs simultaneously.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Structured daily labor proof instruments — Zambia
description: Investrust Bank pools and structures ProofOfWork tokens from verified informal sector workers in Zambia into impact investment products. A portfolio of 10,000 daily labor tokens from market traders, casual construction workers and domestic workers gives investors exposure to the informal economy while providing workers with verifiable work history and access to credit.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Youth Employment Milestone Token
description: Investrust Bank structures project milestone tokens for youth employment and skills development programmes in Zambia. Each token is minted when a young person completes a certified training milestone or employment module. Token proceeds fund the next cohort of apprentices. Investors gain impact credentials while youth gain marketable skills and income.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Agricultural Value Chain Token
description: Investrust Bank structures seasonal agricultural loans into investable tokens for farms of all sizes in Zambia. Institutional investors fund pre-season inputs; smallholder farmers repay at harvest. Structured in tranches from micro (subsistence farmers) to commercial (export farms) so every income level of investor can participate. Reduces hunger and agricultural unemployment.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Community SME Growth Token
underlyingAsset: Structured community SME investment pool — Zambia
description: Investrust Bank structures pools of micro and small enterprise lending into rated investment tokens for Zambia. Market vendors, home bakeries, tailors, mobile phone repairers and informal traders gain working capital. Retail and institutional investors earn blended returns. Portfolio diversification across 500+ SMEs reduces risk while maximising community impact.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Inclusive Economy ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Blended formal and informal economy ETF — Zambia
description: Investrust Bank manages an ETF that tracks a basket of all tokenised asset classes in Zambia — from government bonds and listed equities to farmer warehouse receipts, SME tokens and labor proof-of-work instruments. One token gives an investor exposure to the full breadth of Zambia's economy — from boardrooms to market squares.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Retail Equity Access Token
description: Investrust Bank packages fractional equity in listed Zambia companies into retail-accessible digital tokens starting from one currency unit. An office cleaner, a night-shift nurse, or a rural market trader can now own a piece of Zambia's top companies. Promotes broad-based capital accumulation and reduces wealth inequality.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Community Development Bond Token
description: Investrust Bank structures community development bonds in Zambia with proceeds earmarked for rural electrification, clean water, and digital connectivity — all generating local employment. Token holders receive coupon payments from government guarantees. Accessible from minimum one currency unit to include salary earners and market vendors as bond investors.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Public Finance Act; Community Development Bond Tokenisation Rules

tokenName: Investrust Bank Diaspora Remittance Impact Token
description: Investrust Bank channels diaspora remittances into productive investment in Zambia through impact tokens. Instead of remittances being consumed, they are tokenised into community enterprises, housing, agriculture and SME investments. Family members abroad become investors in their home communities, creating jobs, building assets and generating returns.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Community Mining Revenue Token
description: Investrust Bank structures revenue from artisanal and small-scale mineral extraction in Zambia into regulated investment tokens. Mining communities receive fair prices via transparent on-chain auctions. Token investors gain direct exposure to copper, cobalt, gold and other critical minerals without intermediary exploitation. Environmental compliance is token-gated.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Farmer credit history via verified output — Zambia
description: Investrust Bank structures pools of verified AgriPoW records from thousands of Zambia smallholders into rated impact investment products. The more a farmer's verified output history grows, the higher their token earning rate. Investors fund the next season's inputs; farmers repay through tokenised harvest receipts. Creates a self-reinforcing agricultural prosperity cycle.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investrust Bank Agri-Commerce Supply Chain Token
description: Investrust Bank structures supply chain finance instruments across the agricultural and commerce value chains of Zambia. Transporters, processors, packers and market distributors all participate as token-earning nodes. Supply chain finance injections at each node reduce spoilage, lower prices for consumers and create stable employment for thousands of workers.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024
